title: A made-up story: the biscuit shop
context: A made-up biscuit brand hires an agency to build a website and online shop.
agreed: A new website and shop for a fixed fee of 60k, in twelve weeks.
client_private: Everything is included: site, shop, photography and copywriting. There is no more money.
agency_private: The fee covers design and build. Photography and copywriting are extra.
unknowns: Who supplies the photos and the words, and who pays for them.
intervention_question: When you say everything, what do you picture being handed over on launch day?
signal: One side says everything and the other lists what the fee covers.
